armyRules.name: Entrenched Obstinacy
armyRules.flavor: The Legion digs in and does not leave.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Toughness Characteristic against Shooting Attacks if its Unit did not move during its last Movement phase.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule cannot Rush, and subtracts 1 from the result of its Charge Rolls.
armyRules.condition: against Shooting Attacks, if the unit did not move in its last Movement phase

armyRules.name: Methodical Barrage
armyRules.flavor: The guns work through a target in order, and are slow to turn on a new one.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill Characteristic when making a Shooting Attack against a Unit with the Pinned, Suppressed or Stunned Tactical Status.
drawbacks: A Model with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from the result of its Hit Tests when making a Shooting Attack against a Unit that Rushed during its Controlling Player's last Battle Turn.
armyRules.condition: against a Pinned, Suppressed or Stunned unit

armyRules.name: Siege-Plate Hulls
armyRules.flavor: Iron Warriors armour is built for the long approach, not the race.
benefits: A Vehicle with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Front Armour Value.
drawbacks: A Vehicle with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from its Movement Characteristic.

armyRules.name: The Exacting Eye
armyRules.flavor: He demands the exact range, the exact hour and the exact sacrifice.
benefits: While Perturabo is on the battlefield, friendly Iron Warriors Infantry Units that did not move during their last Movement phase add 1 to the Hit Tests of Shooting Attacks made with Weapons that have the Heavy (X) or Barrage (X) Special Rule.
drawbacks: Friendly Iron Warriors Infantry Units within 12" of Perturabo cannot Rush.
If Perturabo is removed as a casualty, friendly Iron Warriors Units subtract 1 from their Cool Characteristic for the rest of the battle.
armyRules.condition: Heavy or Barrage weapons, if the unit did not move

wargear.name: Fortification kit
wargear.summary: Spades, sandbag lattices and quick-setting ferrocrete foam, hauled across every battlefield and used on all of them.
wargear.text: A Unit equipped with a Fortification kit has the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule, and every Model in it subtracts 1 from its Movement Characteristic.

wargear.name: Bastion rangefinder
wargear.summary: A tripod-mounted ranging array and a gunner who has never missed a measurement.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Bastion rangefinder adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill Characteristic when it makes a Shooting Attack, provided its Unit did not move during its Controlling Player's current Battle Turn.

wargear.name: Mechanicum augmetics
wargear.summary: Bionic limbs and subdermal plating, grafted in by the Legion's own sawbones.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Mechanicum augmetics adds 1 to its Toughness Characteristic and subtracts 1 from its Initiative Characteristic.

wargear.name: Demolition satchel
wargear.summary: A satchel of shaped charges carried to the walls the Legion means to open.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Demolition satchel has the Shaped Charge Special Rule.

wargear.name: Bastion standard
wargear.summary: A banner on an iron pole, hammered into the ground so that charging enemies must come to it.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Bastion standard has the Unyielding Bastion Special Rule.

wargear.name: Ablative bulwark plate
wargear.summary: Layered ceramite slabs that peel away rather than break.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Ablative bulwark plate has the Ablative Layers Special Rule.

wargear.name: Siege-ledger
wargear.summary: A cogitator slate of ranges, wall thicknesses and failure points.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Siege-ledger has the Siege Calculus Special Rule.

wargear.name: Sapper's tunnelling kit
wargear.summary: Augers, props and spades for going under a line rather than over it.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Sapper's tunnelling kit has the Sapper Tunnels Special Rule.

wargear.name: Spall liners
wargear.summary: Quilted ablative sheeting packed behind the hull plates.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Spall liners has the Spall Liners Special Rule.

wargear.name: Fixed-fire core
wargear.summary: A machine-spirit cogitation core tuned for patience and aim.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Fixed-fire core has the Fixed-Fire Protocol Special Rule.

wargear.name: Fault-line survey
wargear.summary: A folded plan of the target's every structural weakness, annotated in his own hand.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Fault-line survey has the Weak Point Surveyed Special Rule.

wargear.name: Warrant of Decimation
wargear.summary: A sealed order bearing the Tyrant's mark, which has never been countermanded.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Warrant of Decimation has the Decimation Without Appeal Special Rule.

modifiers.text: Drilled to the wall: Unyielding Bastion, -1 I.

modifiers.condition: if the unit did not move this turn

modifiers.text: Spall liners: ignores Stunned and Suppressed from Shooting Attacks.
Fixed-fire core: +1 BS if it did not move.
modifiers.condition: if the unit did not move this turn

rules.name: Dug In
rules.summary: Hold the ground long enough and the ground holds you.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule that did not move during its last Movement phase counts as being in Cover against Shooting Attacks, and cannot be given the Pinned Tactical Status, until it next moves.

rules.name: Unbroken Garrison
rules.summary: The Tyrant's guard does not break.
rules.text: While a Unit with this Special Rule is within 12" of Perturabo or a Warsmith, it cannot be given the Pinned or Suppressed Tactical Status. A Unit with this Special Rule can never choose to Fall Back.

rules.name: Machine Certainty
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule is not affected by the Fear (X) Special Rule and cannot be given the Pinned Tactical Status.

rules.name: Through the Breach
rules.summary: Siege infantry go through the walls rather than around them.
rules.text: An enemy Unit that is charged by a Unit with this Special Rule gains no benefit from Cover, Buildings or Fortifications for the rest of that Combat.

rules.name: Shaped Charge
rules.summary: Charges placed with care open the strongest doors.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of a Combat, the Controlling Player may declare that a Model with this Special Rule has the Breaching (3+) Special Rule on all of its melee Weapons until the end of that Combat.

rules.name: Unyielding Bastion
rules.summary: The line stands, and the enemy must come to it.
rules.text: An enemy Unit that makes a Charge against a Unit with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from the result of its Charge Roll.

rules.name: Ablative Layers
rules.summary: Layered plates give way one at a time.
rules.text: The first Wound that a Model with this Special Rule suffers after failing its Saving Throw in each battle is discarded.

rules.name: Siege Calculus
rules.summary: Every wall has a weakness and the ledger knows where it is.
rules.text: At the start of each Shooting phase, the Controlling Player chooses one enemy Unit within 24" of a Model with this Special Rule. Friendly Iron Warriors Units add 1 to the result of their Hit Tests when making Shooting Attacks against that Unit until the end of the phase.

rules.name: Sapper Tunnels
rules.summary: Go under the line, and come up behind it.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule has the Infiltrate (9) Special Rule, but cannot Rush during the first Battle Turn of the battle.

rules.name: Spall Liners
rules.summary: Padding behind the plate takes the hit the plate cannot.
rules.text: A Vehicle with this Special Rule cannot be given the Stunned or Suppressed Tactical Status by a Shooting Attack.

rules.name: Fixed-Fire Protocol
rules.summary: Patience, aim, and nothing else to think about.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill Characteristic when it makes a Shooting Attack, provided its Unit did not move during its Controlling Player's current Battle Turn.

rules.name: Siegemaster of Olympia
rules.summary: The wall is a sum, and he has never failed to solve one.
rules.text: While this Model did not move during its Controlling Player's current Battle Turn, Shooting Attacks it makes ignore the effects of Cover and the Shrouded (X) Special Rule. This Model subtracts 2 from its Movement Characteristic and cannot Rush.

rules.name: The Tyrant's Wrath
rules.summary: The Legion obeys him out of fear, and tonight he lets it show.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Assault phase, the Controlling Player may declare the Tyrant's Wrath. This Model adds 2 to its Attacks Characteristic until the end of that phase, and then every friendly Iron Warriors Unit within 12" of it subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic until the end of the next Player Turn.

rules.name: The Gorgon's Grudge
rules.summary: Some of his brothers he cannot forgive, and he intends to say so in person.
rules.text: This Model adds 1 to its Weapon Skill Characteristic and has the Hatred (Paragon) Special Rule. When there is an enemy Paragon Model within its reach, this Model must declare a Charge against it, or issue or accept a Challenge against it, if able. This Model subtracts 1 from its Initiative Characteristic.

rules.name: Weak Point Surveyed
rules.summary: Every wall has one place it was always going to fall.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of a friendly Shooting phase, the Controlling Player may choose one enemy Vehicle or Fortification within 24" of a Model with this Special Rule. Friendly Iron Warriors Units add 1 to the Hit Tests of Shooting Attacks made against it until the end of that phase.

rules.name: Decimation Without Appeal
rules.summary: When the line wavers, he does not rally it. He thins it.
rules.text: Once per battle, when a friendly Iron Warriors Unit within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule is about to make a Cool Check, the Controlling Player may declare a decimation. That Unit adds 2 to its Cool Characteristic for that Check, but must then remove one Model of the Controlling Player's choice as a casualty.

rites.name: The Bastion Doctrine
rites.flavor: A line that cannot be turned is worth more than ten that cannot be stopped.
benefits: Iron Havocs, Heavy Support Squads and Tactical Support Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Those units gain Dug In: after a Battle Turn in which they did not move, they count as being in Cover against Shooting Attacks and cannot be Pinned.
limitations: No Antigrav units, no Fast Attack units, and no Recon units other than Tarantula Batteries.
Units with Dug In may not start the battle in Reserves.

modifiers.text: The Bastion Doctrine: Line (1), Dug In.

rites.name: Iron Circle Garrison
rites.flavor: Perturabo trusts no one, and so every wall he builds has a guard on the inside.
benefits: Iron Circle Maniples and Dominator Cohorts may fill Troops slots.
Those units gain Unbroken Garrison: they cannot be Pinned or Suppressed while within 12" of Perturabo or a Warsmith.
limitations: Perturabo, a Warsmith or a Warsmith in Artificer armour must lead the army.
Units with Unbroken Garrison may not voluntarily Fall Back.
No Recon, Fast Attack or Heavy Assault units, and at most one Armour unit.

require.note: Perturabo or a Warsmith must lead the army.

rites.name: The Cold Calculus
rites.flavor: A machine does not flinch, and it does not need to be thanked.
benefits: Castellax Battle Maniples may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Castellax gain Machine Certainty: they are not affected by Fear (X) and cannot be Pinned.
limitations: At least two Castellax Battle Maniples are required.
No Tactical, Despoiler, Assault or Inductii Squads.

modifiers.text: The Cold Calculus: Line (1), Machine Certainty.

require.note: Bring at least two Castellax Battle Maniples.

rites.name: Breach and Clear
rites.flavor: The guns open the wall. Then the armour walks through the hole.
benefits: Tyrant Siege Terminators, Tartaros Terminator Siege Squads, Tartaros Terminator Squads and Veteran Breacher Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1) and Move Through Cover.
Those units gain Through the Breach: enemy Units they charge gain no benefit from Cover or Fortifications for the rest of that Combat.
limitations: At least two of those siege infantry squads are required.
No Armour or Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: Breach and Clear: Line (1), Through the Breach, Move Through Cover.

require.note: Bring at least two siege infantry squads.
